sloka: प्रसव्यम् च अपि तम् चक्रुर् ऋत्विजो अग्नि चितम् नृपम् ।स्त्रियः च शोक सम्तप्ताः कौसल्या प्रमुखाः तदा ॥२-७६-२०॥
transliteration: prasavyam ca api tam cakrur ṛtvijo agni citam nṛpam ।striyaḥ ca śoka samtaptāḥ kausalyā pramukhāḥ tadā ॥2-76-20॥

translations.english: Then the priests and other women led by Kausalya who was consumed with grief circumambulated the pyre in the reverse direction as the king's body was engulfed by flames.
